app_store.name: Flow: Desktop Music Player
app_store.subtitle: Stream Songs with Lyrics
app_store.promotional_text: Experience fluid desktop audio with synchronized Romanized lyrics, local playlists, and granular cache controls.
app_store.description:
Flow is a fluid, modern music player crafted for seamless desktop listening.

Enjoy synchronized lyrics with instant phonetic Romanization, build custom playlists locally without mandatory cloud accounts, and keep full control of your storage with per-track cache management.

Key Highlights:
- Real-Time Synced Lyrics: Sing along with syllable-accurate lyric timing and bilingual translations.
- Phonetic Romanization: Toggle instant Romaji, Hangul, and Latin transliteration for international tracks.
- Offline Lyrics Export: Save timestamped .lrc files directly to your device with a single click.
- Zero-Login Local Playlists: Create, curate, and export custom playlists without an account.
- Resilient Playback: Smooth stream buffering prevents mid-track pauses and stuttering.
- Granular Storage Control: Inspect exact disk space per track and prune cached files individually.
- Dedicated Repeat Controls: Easily toggle between repeat off, repeat all, and repeat one.
- Playback Speed Slider: Adjust tempo smoothly from 0.5x to 2.0x while preserving pitch.

Clean design, fast performance, completely free, and built with total respect for your listening privacy.

microsoft_store.title: Flow: Desktop Music Player
microsoft_store.short_description: Fluid desktop music player with synchronized lyrics and local playlist creation.
microsoft_store.description:
Flow is a modern, responsive audio player designed specifically for Windows 10 and Windows 11.

Experience seamless desktop listening with syllable-accurate synchronized lyrics, instant phonetic Romanization for Asian languages, and unmetered local playlist creation without ever being forced to sign in or link a third-party account.

Features:
- Syllable-Synchronized Lyrics: Real-time scrolling lyrics with bilingual translation support.
- Phonetic Romanization: 1-click toggle for Romaji, Hangul, and Latin transcriptions.
- Local-First Playlists: Create and curate custom playlists saved directly to your PC, with full .m3u8 export.
- 1-Click .lrc File Export: Save timestamped lyric files to your drive for offline car stereos and portable DAPs.
- Granular Cache Manager: Inspect disk usage in megabytes and remove individual cached tracks without wiping your storage.
- Resilient Dual-Buffer Audio: Zero-gap playback transitions without micro-pauses or freezes.
- HiDPI Window Adaptation: Beautiful dark-glass interface with adaptive responsive scaling across any monitor resolution.
- Completely Free: Zero ads, zero subscriptions, zero in-app purchases, and zero user telemetry.

google_play.title: Flow: Music and Lyrics Player
google_play.short_description: Fluid music player with synchronized lyrics and local playlist creation.
google_play.full_description:
Flow is a fluid, modern music and lyrics player designed for Android phones, tablets, and digital audio players (DAPs).

Enjoy synchronized lyrics with instant phonetic Romanization, create custom playlists locally on your device without mandatory accounts, and keep total control over your offline storage with track-by-track cache management.

Key Highlights:
- Real-Time Synced Lyrics: Sing along with syllable-accurate timing and bilingual line translations.
- Phonetic Romanization: Toggle instant Romaji, Hangul, and Latin transliteration for Asian and international tracks.
- Offline Lyrics Export: Save timestamped .lrc files directly to your device storage with a single tap for car stereos and offline players.
- Zero-Login Local Playlists: Create, curate, and export custom playlists without an account or cloud login. Standard .m3u8 export keeps your collection portable.
- Resilient Audio Engine: Dual-buffer stream handover prevents stutter and audio dropouts when switching bitrates. Automatically resumes playback after phone calls and GPS announcements.
- External Browser Authentication: Reliable login flow that bypasses outdated embedded system WebViews, ensuring compatibility with Android DAPs.
- Granular Storage Management: View exact disk usage in megabytes for each cached song and prune individual tracks without clearing your entire library.
- Dedicated Playback Controls: Seamless 3-state loop button (Repeat Off, Repeat All, Repeat One) and adjustable 0.5x to 2.0x playback tempo with pitch preservation.
- Background Audio & Media Notification: Native Android MediaSession support with lockscreen controls, notification actions, and Bluetooth headset integration.
- Completely Free & Private: Zero audio ads, zero banners, zero in-app purchases, and zero user tracking.

Experience music the way it was meant to be heard—clean, uninterrupted, and completely in your flow.
